title: Day 1/28 - What Is Infrastructure as Code | Terraform Tutorial For Beginners

chapters.title: Why we need infrastructure as code

description:
Master Infrastructure as Code: Day 1/28 Terraform Azure Tutorial for Beginners

Start your Infrastructure as Code journey with this foundational first lesson in our comprehensive 28-day Azure Terraform course. This video provides the critical building blocks you need to understand why Infrastructure as Code is revolutionizing cloud management and how Terraform fits into the modern DevOps landscape.

In this beginner-friendly introduction, I break down complex concepts into clear, actionable insights covering:
✅ The fundamental concept of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and why it's transforming how we deploy cloud resources
✅ Real-world problems solved by IaC, including inconsistent environments, configuration drift, and scaling challenges
✅ A thorough introduction to HashiCorp Terraform and its distinct advantages over other IaC tools
✅ Detailed comparison between traditional manual infrastructure management versus the IaC approach
✅ The complete Terraform workflow from writing configuration to applying changes
✅ Step-by-step installation guide for setting up Terraform on your system

This video establishes the theoretical foundation needed before we dive into hands-on Azure Terraform implementation in subsequent lessons. Perfect for cloud administrators, DevOps engineers, and developers looking to automate infrastructure deployment and management.

No prior Terraform experience is required—just bring your curiosity and willingness to learn a skill that's increasingly essential in modern cloud environments.

Subscribe to follow the complete 28-day course and transform your cloud infrastructure management approach!

GitHub repo: https://github.com/piyushsachdeva/Terraform-Full-Course-Azure/
